title: Lesson 11: General Multiplication
learningGoals: Use moving multiplier cleanly for long operands.
Connect mental and written left-to-right processes.

lessonSequence.teacherObjective: Open General Multiplication with one fast mental-math hook and connect it to prior knowledge.
lessonSequence.studentAction: Recall what you already know about Revision of Core Multiplication Ideas.

lessonSequence.teacherObjective: Explain the rule behind Revision of Core Multiplication Ideas in simple language.
lessonSequence.studentAction: Repeat the rule for Two-Figure Numbers in One Line in your own words.

lessonSequence.teacherObjective: Model Two-Figure Numbers in One Line step by step on the board.
lessonSequence.studentAction: Watch the example and say the next step before it is revealed.

lessonSequence.teacherObjective: Guide the learner through Two-Figure Numbers in One Line with prompt-based support.
lessonSequence.studentAction: Solve a scaffolded example on Three-Figure Extension.

lessonSequence.teacherObjective: Shift to independent practice on Moving Multiplier for Long Numbers across difficulty levels.
lessonSequence.studentAction: Answer independent questions on Multiplying Binomials.

lessonSequence.teacherObjective: Diagnose errors and reteach the exact step that broke down.
lessonSequence.studentAction: Explain the mistake and correct it.

lessonSequence.teacherObjective: Ask the learner to explain the shortcut before advancing.
lessonSequence.studentAction: Summarize the method for Written Left-to-Right Calculations.
